module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Atomic All-or-None (AON) Group Execution Policy
precondition: Group configured with Execution Policy = 'All-or-None'; Sub-account #3 margin fails.
steps: 1. Sizing engine pre-checks margin across all accounts before submission.
expected_result: Detection of Account #3 failure aborts entire master order; zero child orders sent; master alerted.
actual_result: Basket order endpoint (/v1/oms/{instance}/orders/basket) provides multi-leg all-or-nothing execution policy.
